engine_basis: The physical Throwable slot order remains message/string/code/file/line/trace/previous, followed by ErrorException severity, as registered in Zend/zend_exceptions_arginfo.h and compared by zend_std_compare_objects. Existing COMP140/141 graph comparers preserve current ordinary-object slots/tables, reference dereferencing and copied array COW. COMP146 composes those effects through previous nodes instead of replacing them with a pure order result; no native evaluator supplies semantic answers.

implementation.guard_correction: Independent source review found that the first draft put graph authentication and the recursive pair walker inside one Boolean expression. SpecTec SL/AL eval_bin_exp eagerly evaluates both operands, so a rejected cycle could still reach the unguarded pair walker. The corrected disjoint clauses retain the DIRECT branch and authenticate left then right graphs as ordered premises before paired recursion. Actual and forged cyclic controls exercise this correction.
